title: kuskus - granular processor (Beads)
subtitle: one stereo Beads; deck A = knobs, deck B = attenuverters

knobs.Pitch: A: pitch (+/-24 st, detents); B: pitch attenuverter
knobs.Size: A: size (top = delay mode); B: size attenuverter

pads.Play: A: seed tap (Alt = latch); B: freeze

ring: A: output level (media colour) + time dot; B: input level, cyan when frozen

switches.Mode (L/C/R): A: digital / clean tape / dirty tape; B: Drift = vintage digital
